In response, companies are now positioning workforce adjustments as a transformation of roles rather than outright job elimination.

title: This US island was set to become a resort until 2 storms changed everything
content: Assateague Island was once planned as a major resort community with thousands of homes, roads and commercial areas. Two powerful storms changed that future. A 1933 hurricane split the island, while the 1962 Ash Wednesday storm destroyed roads and structures. The island was later protected as a National Seashore in 1965, preserving its beaches, wildlife and natural coastal habitats.

title: Meta sued by former manager who claims he was fired over immigration letter
content: A former Meta manager filed a lawsuit alleging wrongful termination after objecting to an immigration letter. James Tillinghast claimed the letter overstated an employee's contributions and responsibilities. He also alleged Meta provided preferential immigration support to certain Chinese national employees. Tillinghast believes his dismissal was retaliation for raising these concerns. The lawsuit names Meta Platforms and a manager as defendants.

An inquiry has been initiated to determine the exact cause of the fire.

The building was reportedly erected on a cramped lot, and construction had previously ceased.

content: the warning comes as president Donald Trump steps up pressure on Tehran . he threatens unprecedented sanctions and suggests that Washington retains broad military options in the region . Iran signals readiness for pre-emptive action and is preparing to respond to attacks with broader and faster retaliation .

title: 10 dead as Russia, Ukraine trade fresh strikes after deadly shopping centre attack
content: new strikes come a day after a Russian attack on a shopping centre in Kryvyi Rih killed at least 16 people . one person was killed and another wounded overnight when ballistic missiles struck railway infrastructure . two people were killed in separate missile strike on the Kyiv region .

title: Sajjan Kumar 'role model' post: Sikh leaders protest outside Rahul's residence
content: sikh leaders and families affected by the 1984 anti-sikh riots stage a protest outside Congress leader Rahul Gandhi's residence in new Delhi . some Congress leaders described former party leader Sajjan Kumar as a "hero" and "role model" a dSGMC leader questioned whether the Congress endorsed the remarks .

title: Age limit, two-term cap: DMK passes 9 resolutions for organisational overhaul
content: DMK's executive committee passed nine resolutions aimed at radically restructuring the organisation . the former chief minister says the changes would be "stringent" and difficult for some to accept . he says he will make several changes in the party’s organisational structure .

title: 'Judges are not gods, will not get every judgment right': Justice Sanjay Karol
content: justice Sanjay Karol said judges "are not gods and they will not get every judgment right" he urged other judges to look beyond the facts of a case and see the person behind every litigant . the supreme court bid farewell to justice Karol on his last working day .

title: ‘Cannot accept what US has offered’: Canada PM Carney defiant as trade talks collapse
content: the breakdown comes after the united states imposed 50% tariffs on about $20 billion worth of Canadian products early Saturday . carney warns that Ottawa will retaliate with new tariffs targeting sectors including steel and dairy . the breakdown came after last-ditch trade talks between the two countries collapsed .

title: 'Meeting all about new ideas & perspectives': PM Modi after engaging with 'team Nabin'
content: the meeting came days after the BJP announced its 65-member national team under party president Nitin Nabin . the new team includes 51 neo-nabins and a team of 51 national office-bearers . meeting was first introductory interaction between PM Modi and the newly constituted national team .

title: H1N1 alert: Health ministry lists symptoms to look for as Delhi crosses 1,700 cases
content: swine flu can show up through symptoms including fever, cough, sore throat, headache, runny nose, body aches and fatigue . it advised people not to ignore persistent symptoms and to seek medical advice at the nearest healthcare centre .
